explanation: Performance optimization in computer systems aims to improve the speed and efficiency of program execution.  This involves understanding the hardware-software interaction, utilizing the memory hierarchy effectively, and minimizing bottlenecks.  Optimizations can target various aspects, including algorithm design, data structures, and low-level code manipulation to leverage the underlying architecture.
